column1: # done_enemies (batch 5, _todo rows 351-450) — srcline <TAB> english. Realm badges skipped.

column2: Neither Earth Dragon nor Wyvern; due to an impure bloodline, this is where it stops……
Rainbow Attack (6/7). Where'd all these abilities suddenly come from?!
Mayoi Boshi no Uta (Song of the Lost Star)—— but even lost together, this is straying too far. Did I just hook the Icicle Fish King……?

A seven-character title, huh. Practically the longest name here aside from Baifang [Wildbeast Forest ver.] [BOSS].
(PS: half-width counts as half, so Warship Nexus B6 [BOSS] is also seven characters~)
Seemingly a rather unremarkable Ethereal. When high-damage swarms are the norm, Ethereal isn't anything special either, right?
A Budding Purple Furball? Don't think putting on a hat means nobody recognizes you.
By the way, the Water Prison shouldn't distinguish day from night… if you could see the sky, there'd be no reason it could hold anyone.
A higher-ceiling but gentler aura Furball. Maybe it's what the Water-Soluble Furball looks like grown up?
You got lost too? Looks like there's definitely more than one Icicle Fish King~ wait, can skeletons fish?
So many kinds of Furballs~ not surprising, since the easiest thing to build is a ring circuit, and the life it produces is just a Furball.
Will high-health Fortified monsters be a problem down the line? The multiplier's already 40% now……
Shenglü City has fallen, and greeting us is… Xianlü City? When did "Acyl-Chloride City" join in, lol.
The Lord's Manor's standard issue is a white uniform and skull mask, but after centuries in the Water Prison, this uniform has been dyed blue by the water element.
Keeping its red robe in a place where everything is blue is already proof of strength.
The Elder's been gone so long — is the sect okay…? All realm and no strength, like a plump XP ball.
You might not be able to tell here, but it's really blended into the environment. Neko can't see the huge damage numbers……
Rainbow Attack (7/7). Aren't you falling a bit behind?
A powerful mage, doubling as all three forms: buff/heal/attack.
Hey hey, this one's a bit half-hearted… do berserkers have no human rights?
This one's mana looks a bit strong. Super-enhanced stats, with all skills fully retained.
Neko's dragon-clan ranking: Flood Dragon << Earth Dragon < Wyvern << Ancient Dragon.
This organization's pretty strong… though the Bloodkill Hall technique and the Water Prison rules do make a fine pair.
A backbone in the literal sense. No idea whether the Lord's Manor employees signed some Stellaris-style permanent-employment contract — even like this, they still belong to the Lord's Manor.
Already entered the illusion, but the fight goes on! By the way, you can actually bring your outside gear in here.
Hey hey, version update! There's light everywhere here, so what use are you?
At the same table as the Green-Skinned Monster! This one's just as half-hearted as that thing.
A bow at its chest, but it looks weighed down with worries. That outfit isn't stolen, is it……
It can actually still poison you at high temperature. Just defense-kill Neko and it's fine~ (But if you can see this, it means it failed!)
The Blue-Hat Wanderer is always imitated, but at 400% health it's never been surpassed.
Light-Chase……? Since it can break Flaming Furball's defense, you're probably near 2e9 Attack+Defense too.
It ditched its day job — Magic Attack. Mage disqualification! Definitely counts, right?! This is the price of deep♂dark♂fantasy.
Is the skeleton corpse-guard planning to form an MC squad? Like this — bring a creeper, a spider, and an enderman, and start a band……
You've rescued the princess! You can call it here and consider yourself to have "beaten the game," or you can choose to go on…… wrong crossover. The princess doesn't have red wings……
Rainbow Attack (8/7). Did we get the count wrong from the very start……
I, Shaxue, hereby swear! I will never again mistake a crow for a horse like last time!
A life split off from a single drop of blood in the Blood Demon Sea. Only late-Rank-7 combat power, but abundant life force.
It looks cunning. Has a Shadow-Nightmare clansman reincarnated?
A cornered lost powerhouse who stumbled into the Water Prison and, through the slaughter, grasped Domain Tier 3…… what a great story. Too bad this barrier isn't that kind of true inheritance ground.
Isn't something mixed up here? Above and below are both Rank-8 Peak, and you're only early Rank 8……
If the health multiplier keeps rising like this, these rock monsters will eventually become a problem? The inner armor's A.mul will protect everyone!
Spiders are absolutely the strongest Wildbeasts. High-percentage, uncapped healing every turn.
Same weakness as that BOSS-tier one. If you can kill four, you can kill it!
I am the pinnacle of Blue-Jade professionals! Who can kill me, who dares kill me?
From footsoldier to general, the stats jumped five orders of magnitude…… has the 【Crypt Insect Calamity】 reached immortal-deity tier?
So staying up all night without sleeping lets you enter someone else's Inner-Demon illusion! My store of weird knowledge grows again.
Hits really hard! But its life is like a candle in the wind… a bonfire in a typhoon? Anyway, very easy to snuff out.
So it was you, kid, who sent the Fortify squad member next to the aura monster?
Lately, the shiny variant everyone's been catching — is it this one?
Even brighter! Bewitch…… come to think of it, it's an illusion, yet is it really the first enemy with this attribute?
How does this creature mimic Sister's appearance…? Clothes can be imitated, but what about the skin?
Legend says that in a timeline where witch-power flew everywhere, many Lingering-Snow Spirit Arrays were released into the Crypt. Thankfully, nothing like that happened here.
Adding a "Dawn" in front of the name really does sound cooler! An infuriating bat that gains more health the more you hit it……
Lucky the Barrier Lake's Blue-Hat Wanderer didn't show up here wearing an even bigger hat. Otherwise it'd probably have a few trillion health.
The illusion even replicated the corresponding city residents' weaknesses! The way to no-damage it is now obvious.
This one too! Though the Ice Palace illusion itself is deep in the Yangang Fief, the Spirit in the illusion is manifested from fear.
Even its skull has already blackened. Its aura…… actually got a bit stronger?
The 【Ruins Wind-Chaser】's concept-disturbance carried over into the illusion! After all, Light-Chase as a mob skill is way overtuned……
Heh, all grown up. Its Shield Drain multiplier is ten times higher too. But — its Basic Attack Multiplier went up way more than tenfold!
Is there a chance…… I mean just a chance…… that it has a pile of pre-battle self-buff attributes we just don't know about?
Maybe I'll never forget the fear of being dominated by the Blood Edge B1. Also, Health Limit…… did Restraint release a 3.0 version?!
A simple skill, extreme…… take it up with my Moonwheel!
I get the reasoning, but why aren't you 32×32? So Otherworld Gate was a portal all along!
Terrifying glass-cannon…… where'd your Swift go! You don't think something this squishy can still hit people, do you?
The backbone went from bone to a slick mech! No wonder the Yangang Lord's Manor never seemed all that strong.
Its means of buffing itself and debuffing enemies are downright masterful. When will Neko get to learn these?
Version update…… now piling on stats without high purity is useless. Take it up with my Basic Attack Multiplier!

Generally, base stats exceeding the normal Peak by 2x qualify as 【Overload/Limit-Break】, earning ranks like 【Minion/Human-Rank】……
but for clarity, Neko's RPG uses plus signs for everything!
Very sorry, assassination and the like don't work here — inside the combat box, you're the target!
The 【Ancient Dragon】 is the strongest dragon-kind here! Every one has the bloodline of an adult Skyhigh-Tier Peak. Though it probably won't grow up.
Remember the 【Giant Vanguard】 from the infinite Secret Realm…? If the realm had no cap, at floor 891,880 it would have this one's attack strength.
Another one that wandered in! I really want to learn Sky Sword…… Basic Attack Multiplier isn't lacking, but the attack multiplier-region sure is.
It has extremely deep reserves; if it wanted to break through, it could at any time. But becoming a member of the 【Heart Spirit】 is too dark a future, after all……
The weakest Skyhigh-1 is still Skyhigh-1! Sorry, the earlier boss-fight abilities have been retracted…… want me to add some stats to Eve?
Restraint Potion · highlight moment! Ask "delete it?" again? Now you can't delete it!
On death, it summons a random enemy from the current map. Forcing you to swing a few more times……
Teacher Fu Xuefeng of Bat Studies~ I still remember you~ punch by punch~ knocking me into the mist~
A puppet that can rival Skyhigh-Tier Rank 1 must be quite valuable. These are part of the City Gate Battle prizes too!
Why are the mutated Wildbeasts all bats? Is it because of the large biomass base plus decent base stats?
Ten Sky-8s counter-conquering a Skyhigh-1. This is our esteemed spellcaster class! Oh, and the attack speed isn't a typo.
A squad that deepens wounds through continuous slashing. Many effective hits compressed into one gives it Skyhigh-Tier armor-breaking power. Oh, and this attack speed isn't a typo either.
Friendly tip: switching to Superstar is no use for breaking its defense.
It actually resides at Yangang City's various checkpoints, its psychokinesis blanketing several city gates for thorough inspection. But if it really came to a fight, could this one hold you back……
It's glowing green! By Wien's displacement law, its color temperature is roughly 5400K. As for why the sun isn't green…… probably a matter of cone-cell sensitivity.
Fellow Daoist, come into my Human-Sovereign Banner for a chat~ when can Neko consider forging a Human-Sovereign Banner?
A goblin of a strong Bloodfall clan…… we urgently need paladins to purify them.
Knowledge is power! I've attained enlightenment! —— shouting this, he charged right in.
